name: Ambiguous Face Handling with Connected Components
definition: A strategy to handle ambiguous faces in contouring to avoid non-manifold edges by selecting specific connected components (white vs blue) based on the number of ambiguous faces per cell.
summary: Ambiguous Face Handling with Connected Components resolves topological ambiguities in isosurface extraction by selecting white or blue surface patches based on ambiguous face counts, preventing non-manifold edges.
